# Construction 360 Ltd

> Integrated Construction, Architectural Builds & Structural Engineering across London and Essex.

## Overview
Construction 360 Ltd delivers turnkey design-and-build, residential extensions, structural engineering, commercial fit-outs, and renovations under one accountable management team.

- **Website**: https://construction360.co
- **Email**: info@construction360.co
- **Phone**: +44 203 930 9629
- **Headquarters**: 73 Thrale Road, London, SW16 1NU, United Kingdom
- **Company Number**: 17277526 (Registered in England and Wales)

## Primary Services
- **Design & Planning**: Architectural concepts, planning permission applications, structural calculations, and building control submissions.
- **Residential Construction**: House extensions, loft conversions, full-house renovations, basements, and new builds.
- **Structural Works**: Steel installation, load-bearing wall removals, foundation underpinning, and reinforced concrete.
- **Commercial & Fit-Out**: Office refurbishment, retail interiors, MEP services, and commercial renovations.
- **Tendering Standard**: Fixed-price tenders, transparent bills of quantities, and disciplined delivery schedules.

## Service Coverage
- Greater London (Streatham, Wimbledon, Woodford, Chigwell, Kensington, Wandsworth, etc.)
- Essex (Chelmsford, Brentwood, Epping, Buckhurst Hill, etc.)
